description: Let each window's local chrome sidebar listen for config-reloaded/config-error events (Task 10's hot-reload), drive window-move drag (the sidebar's `data-tauri-drag-region` invokes the capability-gated `plugin:window|start_dragging`, wired to the config's `sidebar_drag` flag), and run chrome-core's in-app updater (check/download/install + relaunch, gated by the config's `auto_update` flag). The chrome is each window's local (App-URL) main webview; content tabs load remote (`http://127.0.0.1:{port}/`) URLs, and this capability has no `remote` block (local-only, the default), so Tauri denies these permissions to remote content by origin regardless of label — the sidebar gets them, a doc's content webview never does.
